nav.title: Workspace administration
nav.guestsHint: Clients and partners with limited access
nav.teamsHint: How the organization is laid out
nav.transferHint: Hand boards from people leaving to people staying
gate.title: You don't have access to this area
overview.alertOneAdmin: There's only 1 active admin. Promote someone else so you don't lose access to administration.
overview.alertLinksNoPassword_one: {count} board has an active public link without a password.
overview.alertLinksNoPassword_other: {count} boards have an active public link without a password.
overview.alertInvitesExpiring_one: {count} invitation expires in the next 3 days.
overview.alertInvitesExpiring_other: {count} invitations expire in the next 3 days.
overview.simulatedText: In local mode there are no other real people. Create simulated users (2 members and 1 B2B guest) to try out roles, sharing and “View as…”.
overview.localNote: They can't sign in with a password: use “View as…” in the header.
members.removeNote: Removing = suspending and anonymizing name and email. Boards and history stay; transfer the person's boards first.
guests.description: B2B guests sign in, but only see the projects and boards they were invited to.
teams.description: Each team has members, projects (folders), boards and its own template directory.
teams.empty: No teams yet. Start with “+ New team”.
teams.projectMoved: Project moved along with its boards
teams.noTemplates: none yet (save one from the board menu)
policies.domainsHint: Empty = any domain. Subdomains are included.
policies.domainInvalid: Invalid domain. Use something like company.com.
policies.requireDomain: Members only with emails from these domains
policies.requireDomainHint: Invitations and role changes to member/admin require a listed domain. B2B guests are exempt.
policies.title: Workspace policies
policies.description: They apply to the whole organization. Every change goes into the audit with before and after.
policies.allowPublicLinksHint: Off: Share stops offering a link and existing links stop opening.
policies.requirePassword: Require a password on public links
policies.requirePasswordHint: Links without a password stop opening until someone sets one.
policies.maxLifetimeHint: Also applies to existing links. Empty = no limit.
policies.allowViewerExportHint: This is the ceiling: no public link can allow downloads while this is off.
policies.allowGuestsHint: Off: guests see nothing and new ones can't be invited.
policies.membersInviteGuests: Members can invite clients and partners
policies.guestExpiryHint: Applied to new guests and to their board access. Empty = no end date.
policies.membersCreateProjectsHint: In the teams they belong to. Teams stay admin-only.
policies.trashRetentionHint: After that the board is erased for good (automatically, when the app opens).
policies.snapshotHint: Used by the boards' Version history.
audit.description: Invitations, roles, public links, policies, trash and transfers. What happens inside each board is in that board's Activity log.
audit.empty: No events recorded in this period.
audit.truncated_one: Showing the latest 300 of {count}. Export the CSV to see everything.
audit.truncated_other: Showing the latest 300 of {count}. Export the CSV to see everything.
audit.actions.loginLocked: Too many attempts on the account
audit.actions.adminCreatedViaCli: Admin created from the command line
transfer.step1Text: Pick the person who's leaving (or changing roles). Nothing is erased.
transfer.step2Text: {name}'s boards go to an active member or admin account.
transfer.noRecipients: There's no other active member or admin account.
transfer.step3Text: Untick anything that shouldn't change owner. Personal Space boards go to the recipient's Personal Space.
transfer.noBoards: This person doesn't own any boards.
transfer.suspendHint: Offboarding: the person can no longer sign in, but history and data stay.
transfer.doneText_one: {count} board now belongs to {to} (previously {from}). Recorded in the audit.
transfer.doneText_other: {count} boards now belong to {to} (previously {from}). Recorded in the audit.
nav.backupHint: Export and restore the whole workspace
policies.allowlistInvalid: Invalid id on the list (use lowercase reverse-dns, e.g. dev.ludraw.tema-grafite): {ids}
audit.actions.passwordResetViaCli: Password reset from the command line
policies.allowLocalMode: Allow local mode on this server
policies.allowLocalModeHint: Shows “Continue without an account” and “Use only in this browser” in the app served by this server. Local Mode data stays only in each person’s browser, outside the server and its policies.
policies.distinctPresenceColors: Different colors for each person on live boards
policies.distinctPresenceColorsHint: When two people have the same (or a very similar) color, the server gives whoever joined later a clearly different color for the cursor, outlines and avatar.
access.title: Access requests ({count})
access.description: People who asked from the sign-in screen or through the invite link. Approving creates an invitation; the person sets the password when accepting.
access.policyOff: The “Accept access requests” policy is off: only requests made through the general invite link arrive.
access.approvedToast: Request approved: the invitation was created.
access.closedToast: Request closed: the person already had an account.
access.noMailNote: Without e-mail on the server nobody proves the address: deliver the invitation through a channel you trust.
access.noAdminHint: Administrators join only through a direct invitation.
access.approveText: An invitation will be created for {email} with the access below.
access.approvedMailed: We sent the invitation by e-mail to {email}. The link below also works.
access.approvedLink: Give this link to {email}; the person sets the password when accepting.
links.title: Invite links
links.description: One link for several people, with a fixed role, validity, use limit and optional domain.
links.newText: Whoever opens the link joins with the role and access chosen here.
links.howMail: With e-mail on the server, each person confirms the address before the account is created.
links.howNoMail: Without e-mail on the server, each use becomes a request in the queue; approving creates an invitation and counts one use.
links.readyText: Share this address with whoever should join.
links.copyNow: Copy it now: for security the server keeps only a fingerprint of the link and cannot show it again. If you lose it, turn it off and create another.
policies.allowAccessRequestsHint: The sign-in screen offers “Request access”. Requests arrive under Members and only become invitations with your approval.
links.onceNote: Each link's address is shown only when it's created. Lost it? Turn it off and create another with the same rules.
mail.title: E-mail sending
mail.description: SMTP server used for password recovery, e-mail confirmation and invitations. Server variables override what is set here, field by field.
mail.statusOff: Off: invitations work by link and passwords are reset by an administrator.
mail.enabledLockedHint: The server sets LUDRAW_SMTP_HOST: sending is always on.
mail.passwordSetPlaceholder: Set — leave blank to keep it
mail.passwordWillRemove: The password will be removed when you save.
mail.noKey: To store the password here, set LUDRAW_JWT_SECRET on the server. Without it, only an SMTP server without authentication works.
mail.keyChanged: The server key changed since the password was saved: enter the password again.
mail.appUrlMissing: Set LUDRAW_APP_URL (or LUDRAW_PUBLIC_URL) on the server to set up e-mail: without it, e-mails would have no links.
mail.outbox: The server writes e-mails to a development folder (LUDRAW_MAIL_OUTBOX_DIR). To use this panel, remove that variable.
mail.problemMissingPassword: There is a user but no password.
policies.allowDomainSignup: Allow sign-up with the organization’s e-mail
policies.allowDomainSignupHint: People with an e-mail on a registered domain (exactly the same, no subdomains) create their own account as members after confirming the e-mail. Requires e-mail sending and a registered domain.
policies.domainSignupReached: Daily limit reached for {domains}: {max} new accounts in 24 hours. New sign-ups from that domain resume when the period rolls over (LUDRAW_DOMAIN_SIGNUP_MAX_PER_DAY).
